title: Pipeline next step prints an empty command when the run's epic is unresolved
description:
mwt made the command builders refuse an empty operand, but two drill-in next-step sentences still concatenate the command unconditionally. For a run whose epic cannot be resolved they read '… —  takes it up', with the command missing. TestNoClearingCommandCarriesAnEmptyOperand does not cover them.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/pipeline.go:620,636

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding aabcb9eb59c61590692b55f20f4e606a6fa1903d44c40b9801b470dd87a4d259 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-pv7/attempt-42): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A2. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/aabcb9eb59c61590692b55f20f4e606a6fa1903d44c40b9801b470dd87a4d259.json on the run branch.
